handback.title: The all tests check passes with no tests
handback.summary: A repo with no tests yet passes the all tests check, and the run says so.
handback.user_story: An owner with no tests yet sees the all tests check pass, told the repo has no tests yet.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the all tests check runs on a repo with no tests, it succeeds.
acceptance_criteria.words: treat "no tests collected" as an empty baseline, not a crash, in the testmon baseline and wherever the full suite would hit the same exit code

edge_cases.case: Tests whose setup crashes still fail the check.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the all tests check runs on a repo with no tests, the run shows a notice saying so.
acceptance_criteria.words: say on the run that the repo has no tests yet

edge_cases.case: A repo with one passing test shows no such notice.
